units.source_text: 这是照顾，不忍心让名人在棋盘前继续坐下去。

en.t: This was a considerate gesture; they could not bear to make the Master keep sitting in front of the go board.

units.source_text: 而后由大竹七段独自封99。

en.t: After that, Otake 7-dan sealed move 99 by himself.

units.source_text: 名人也就不一定非要在场不可了。

en.t: The Master no longer absolutely had to be present.

units.source_text: 名人歪着脖颈沉思：是站起来走呢，还是坐着不动？

en.t: The Master tilted his neck and pondered: should he stand up and leave, or remain seated without moving?
